disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin reads system credentials or sensitive files (SSH private keys, cloud credentials, credential lists, environment keys, etc.), and verified the state persistence read/write surface: the plugin only reads and writes its own ledger file data/whale-girl/state.json, no credential read paths or hardcoded secrets were found.

checked_items.en: The desktop companion and browser client only consume pet status data returned by this plugin's routes, not involving host credentials; no wallet, mnemonic, or financial sensitive surfaces detected.

动态沙箱未启用（无 l4-sandbox.json 产物），运行时行为仅静态审查。

能力声明无显式 manifest 声明字段，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断（network/shell/modelFacing 均无，fs=write 仅写自家账本文件）；desktop/ 目录为独立桌面伴侣应用（package.json files 不含 desktop/，不随插件包分发），其默认仅连接本机 127.0.0.1:3080。

静态预扫 16 条命中逐条裁决（全部良性，无 finding）：DSH-C05（DG-R4-53）@ AGENTS.md:44、decisions/implemented/bug-fix/2026-08-08-node-half-hardening.md:20、decisions/implemented/bug-fix/2026-08-08-sprite-empty-stage.md:7 与 :23、scripts/verify-client-smoke.mjs:6——均为开发文档/注释中的 curl 一词，指本地测试工具，无运行时外发；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas/acl-manifests.json:1——Tauri 自动生成的 ACL 权限清单，超长单行属生成产物，非混淆；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ lib/client.js:209——转义密度来自 esbuild 打包产物把 CSS 注释中文转成 \uXXXX 转义，对应源码 lib/client/index.mjs:44 为普通中文注释，非混淆；DSH-X05（DG-R3-57）@ lib/client/index.mjs:1122、:1135 与 lib/client.js:1086、:1099——键盘监听为无障碍菜单快捷键（回车/空格开合菜单、Esc 关闭），无键盘记录、剪贴板或凭据调用；DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）@ scripts/build-client.mjs:7、scripts/gates/run.mjs:7、scripts/gates/verify-config-sync.mjs:24、scripts/verify-client-behavior.mjs:8、scripts/verify-client-smoke.mjs:8——全部位于开发/构建/验证脚本（esbuild 打包、门禁编排、Chrome 冒烟），不在运行时插件入口可达路径，verify-config-sync 的动态函数仅对本仓源码中的纯字面量对象求值。
limits.en:
Dynamic sandbox not enabled (no l4-sandbox.json artifact), runtime behavior only reviewed statically.

Capability declarations have no explicit manifest declaration fields; declared_capabilities inferred from actual code (network/shell/modelFacing all absent, fs=write only writes its own ledger file); the desktop/ directory is a standalone desktop companion application (package.json files does not include desktop/, so it is not distributed with the plugin package), which by default only connects to local 127.0.0.1:3080.

package.json does not declare engines.dsh; compatibility entry marked as untested per the official bundle form.

Static pre-scan hit 16 items adjudicated one by one (all benign, no findings): DSH-C05 (DG-R4-53) @ AGENTS.md:44, decisions/implemented/bug-fix/2026-08-08-node-half-hardening.md:20, decisions/implemented/bug-fix/2026-08-08-sprite-empty-stage.md:7 and :23, scripts/verify-client-smoke.mjs:6 — all are the word "curl" in development docs/comments, referring to local test tooling, no runtime exfiltration; DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) @ desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas/acl-manifests.json:1 — Tauri auto-generated ACL permission manifest, the extra-long single line is a generated artifact, not obfuscation; DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) @ lib/client.js:209 — the escape density comes from esbuild bundle output converting Chinese in CSS comments to \uXXXX escapes, corresponding to plain Chinese comments in source lib/client/index.mjs:44, not obfuscation; DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57) @ lib/client/index.mjs:1122, :1135 and lib/client.js:1086, :1099 — keyboard listener is for accessibility menu shortcuts (Enter/Space to open/close menu, Esc to close), no keylogging, clipboard, or credential calls; DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) @ scripts/build-client.mjs:7, scripts/gates/run.mjs:7, scripts/gates/verify-config-sync.mjs:24, scripts/verify-client-behavior.mjs:8, scripts/verify-client-smoke.mjs:8 — all in development/build/verification scripts (esbuild bundling, gate orchestration, Chrome smoke), not in the runtime plugin entry reachable path; the dynamic function in verify-config-sync only evaluates pure literal objects in this repository's source.
